notes: Settings is now a centered, see-through CLOSR panel with Notifications, Display, Email, Connections and Your data (Export/Import moved here). New notification bell (brief SCANR/TRACKR load updates) with the refresh button beside it; the SCANR title bar is gone. Route ticker under the top bar shows the trucks closest to delivery in their TRACKR colors, and SCANR rows now carry the same load colors. Two-click Sign out for Salesforce, Outlook and RingCentral; while signed out of Salesforce no data shows. My leads shows only leads you added (newest first, last 30 days by default); companies from your inbox moved to Find leads.
